column2: I really resent pictures of human bodies being presented to me. I made a life decision that I prefer not to see stuff like that unless I actively choose.

This is the TrueCrypt guy. Sometimes it feels like I just missed out on big history. VeraCrypt's license still includes him: https://veracrypt.io/en/VeraCrypt%20License.html

What on earth, man. I remember the name being familiar for software reasons back in the 2000s because a bunch of people were talking about TrueCrypt back then and not trusting anonymous software and this and that. He became a crime boss? This is a revelation for me as big as the ReiserFS situation.

I read this when it came out and was floored

There’s also a great book I think called The Mastermind
Fun aside, there's a theory that Paul Le Roux is Satoshi Nakamato.
its hard to believe that this world even exists, that people out there run around thinking these sorts of things. but it does and they do.
